text:

input.title: Add two draft notes

text:
Both notes are saved.

- First ("Lemma 2 needs a citation.") returned `{ text: "Lemma 2 needs a citation." }`
- Second ("Section 3 is done.") returned `{ text: "Section 3 is done." }`

The module's `add` takes the note text as a single string argument and echoes it back in a `{ text }` object.
